question: The three successive discounts of 18%, 12% and 10% is equivalent to a single discount of:
solution:
Given:

Discount (d1) = 18%

Discount (d2) = 12%

Discount (d3) = 10%

Formula:

Effective discount = d1 + d2 - d₁ × d₂ over 100

Where “d1” and “d2” are successive discounts offered.

Calculation:

Effective discount = 18 + 12 - 18 × 12 over 100 = 30 - 2.16 = 27.84

Final discount = 27.84 + 10 - 27.84 × 10over 100 = 37.84 - 2.784 = 35.056%

∴ The final effective discount is 35.056%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__ Let the initial price be 100.

Price after 1st discount = 100 - 18 = 82

Price after 2nd discount = 82 - 12 over 100 × 82 = 82 - 9.84 = 72.16

Price after 3rd discount = 72.16 - 10 over 100 × 72.16 = 72.16 - 7.216 = 64.944

Effective discount = 100 - 64.944 = 35.056%

∴ The effective discount is 35.056%.
